user.title: Breakage Radar
user.description:
Home Assistant announces API removals about a year ahead. Custom integrations often don't get updated in time, and the warning only ever reaches your log file.

Breakage Radar checks the custom integrations installed here against a public index of those removals, and against your own installed code, so you find out before an upgrade breaks something.

The index is downloaded from {index_url} every 12 hours. Nothing is uploaded and no account is needed.

init.title: Breakage Radar options
init.description: An integration breaking inside the alert window gets its own notification. Everything further out is listed together in one summary, so a deadline a year away doesn't sit in your notifications for months.

data_description.alert_window_days: Home Assistant releases once a month, on the first Wednesday, so each 30 days is roughly one release of warning.

integrations_affected.title: {count} custom {noun} will break in a future release
integrations_affected.description:
{count} installed custom {noun} {verb} Home Assistant APIs that are scheduled for removal. Nothing is broken today. The first deadline is {earliest_due}.

**What breaks, and when**

{schedule}

Each one has to be fixed by whoever maintains it, so the useful next step is to check those repositories for a newer release. Anything breaking within {window} days gets its own notification with a direct link, which you can change in this integration's options.

The exact file and line for every finding is on `sensor.breakage_radar_affected`, and the full report is under **Download diagnostics** on this integration's page.

[Look up any integration on the public board]({board_url})
